verdict.rationale:
Crossmint's Agent Wallets flow directly matches the story: a user-owned, non-custodial wallet is created, the agent is authorized as a delegated signer with a scoped, revocable permission set (spend cap, counterparties, time window) enforced onchain, and the agent then transacts without per-action prompts while the user retains control and can revoke at any time (crossmint-docs-3, crossmint-supp-4, crossmint-supp-1, crossmint-docs-14). Wallet webhooks additionally notify on transfers, giving some operational visibility into wallet activity (crossmint-docs-17, crossmint-docs-38).

missing for 10: explicit documentation of a balance-check/balance-visibility API or dashboard specifically for agent-held wallets, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
